items.summary: Implement a guided Blender/image-to-Godot asset pipeline with hash-bound technical evidence, human review and repository-scoped PR delivery.
scope: Jason accepted the corrected guard presentation and requested these settings as character standards. Calm four-second idle, anatomically fitted weapon grips, carrying hand poses and twelve-clip/equipment review criteria are now documented; shared idle defaults include the hero blend-space. Exact sockets remain rig/weapon-specific. Helmet design is deferred as a separate asset issue. Guard pilot gate passes; the real reviewed-PR gate remains open.

Bow poses, campaign defaults and accepted sword bytes are unchanged. Guard correction is ready for re-review: rejected shoulder blocks removed in a retained-source derivative, and the approved sword is seated within the closed-fist cavity with the shaft aligned across the knuckles. Anatomical grip/contact checks cover all twelve clips; shared-rig, review-control, potion, M4 and fluid-combat checks and the latest fifteen rendered views pass. Correction hashes/captures are recorded in the game evidence folder. Barrel stays excluded; human guard reapproval and real reviewed-PR delivery remain open.

Jason selected the guard as the next gate and excluded barrel acceptance from closure. The guard-only source review now covers all twelve clips, sword/bow switching, motion pause, rotation and close-up/walk-around. Focused input/equipment/save-isolation checks, existing potion regression, project import and Forward+ render pass. Human guard review remains pending.

Jason accepted the 75 cm soft-platinum sword's appearance, scale and review presentation ("Love that", "looks good"). The scoped acceptance receipt binds verified unchanged source/master/runtime and exact hosted review package for revision eddd76f6-7163-4002-8eea-4365852e2ca0. Equipping/hand alignment, combat/hitboxes, campaign pickups/saves and cold-import stability remain open. This does not clear other art gates or final delivery.

Jason requested a smaller soft-platinum sword. A new editable source is 0.75 m long with neutral metal targeting the supplied #D9D9D9 swatch, preserved leather/detail and corrected OpenGL normals. Hosted technical/Godot checks, authenticated review download/hash checks, fresh extracted-project smoke and desktop/mobile download links pass. Neutral sky reflections are installed in review/capture templates, with a real rendered-metal regression check covering both templates; sampled metal albedo matches #D9D9D9 and leather remains unchanged. Revised hosted source: eddd76f6-7163-4002-8eea-4365852e2ca0. Human acceptance and weapon integration remain open; original inputs and historical packages are preserved.

Eight Blender regression cases pass, and every evaluated sword vertex matches after normalization within 0.000001 m. The corrected export retains base color, metallic/roughness, normal and AO. items.title: Implement gear-based inventory and fixed cottage stash
items.summary: Build Alex's spatial inventory with gear-dependent character capacity and a fixed personal stash in the purchased cottage, using the supplied equipment/grid references as the visual direction.
scope: Campaign source now uses equipment slots, original item icons and spatial storage grids. Pockets start at nine cells. Storage-class bags have individual capacities; one primary bag is worn at a time. Ordinary clothing has no container. The cottage chest stays fixed at 80 cells regardless of gear. Mira sells the first bag types; capacities and prices remain provisional review values.

Whole-stack drag/drop, item footprints, stack limits, equipment/potion/trading integration, atomic full-inventory rewards and lossless historical-inventory migration are implemented. Saves persist item IDs, quantities, positions, gear and stash contents. Nonempty storage gear cannot be removed. One active container per gear slot is supported; droppable bag instances and NPC ownership remain future work.

Seven focused checks pass in an isolated Godot 4.7.2 copy, including inventory, trading, relationships and cottage/mill paths. Rendered engine mouse-drag tests and layout review pass. The latest shared-checkout campaign-inventory, M4 and cottage checks also pass. A dedicated inventory review build opens an owned-house demonstration with separate review saves; packaged startup and fresh-process save/reload pass. Existing campaign EXEs were not replaced. No user acceptance or full-system maturity promotion is claimed.

acceptance.text: Implement and test spatial storage, bounded stacks and atomic transfers.
Integrate campaign equipment/grid UI, item use/trading and historical-save migration.
Support all three player bag types with individual capacities; only one bag is worn at a time, and ordinary gear has no storage.
Add an ownership/proximity-gated house chest with fixed capacity and persistent contents.
Produce a separate review build and verify packaged startup plus fresh-process save/reload.
Jason/Alex accept layout, dragging, capacity, pricing and gameplay use in the campaign.
Support persistent droppable/retrievable bag instances, abandonment/loss and NPC bag owners.
Add per-bag upgrades and crafted/unlocked mining/lumberjack Bags of Holding; ordinary ore/wood stacks cap at 12.
Integrate bulky-bag NOISY -10% sneak/pickpocket during stealth and garment bonus tradeoffs when those mechanics exist.
Accept the complete gameplay and save/restart loop without item loss or duplication.
